newsitem.title: USA: Dart Group offers settlement with Hafts.
newsitem.headline: Dart Group offers settlement with Hafts.

text.p: Dart Group Corp said it has conditionally authorized a possible settlement and the severing of ties between it and the founding Haft family, on terms that have been negotiated in recent months.
The executive committee of the company's board of directors said the members of the Haft family have not, at this time, committed to these possible settlement agreemenets.

In a statement, the Dart Group said it would make aggregate payments in connection with these possible settlements of approximately $90 million (including a loan of $10 million), part of which would be deferred.
It is anticipated that Dart would pay substantially all of this amount, though a portion (yet to be determined) could be allocated to affiliates Trak Auto Corp and Crown Books Corp.

Under the several terms of a settlement, the company said Herbert Haft, the founder and present chiarman and chief executive officer, would retire, and no member of the Haft family would continue to be involved with the company or its principal operating subsidiaries as an officer, director or shareholder.
